edgegap_api_token.title: Edgegap API token
edgegap_api_token.description: Your Edgegap API token (the UUID only), from https://app.edgegap.com/user-settings?tab=tokens. Used by the hosted Edgegap MCP server to manage your apps, versions and deployments. It is organization-wide, so keep it private.
